hyperedges.description: All four external entities (Student, Teacher/Admin, SSLCommerz Gateway, Superadmin) exchange data bidirectionally with the central Prepare Yourself Platform (Process 0) in the Level 0 context diagram
Superadmin performs admin actions through P7 Superadmin Analytics, which aggregates data from all four data stores (D1-D4)
Subscription payment flow: user initiates payment via P6, SSLCommerz Gateway processes it and returns IPN callback

hyperedges.label: Contest scoring and leaderboard flow
hyperedges.description: P3.5 writes/reads scores in Contest DB, feeds updated scores to P3.6 leaderboard generation, which supplies ranks back to P3.3 participation

hyperedges.label: Contest setup and activation flow
hyperedges.description: Teacher supplies contest details to P3.1, which references P3.2 question assignment and triggers P3.4 activation
Payment confirmation flow: SSLCommerz IPN POST is received by P6.5, callback data passes to P6.6 which verifies the IPN signature via P6.3 and saves the subscription to the Subscription DB
Checkout initiation flow: Student views plans (P6.1), clicks Buy to initiate checkout (P6.2), plan ID drives redirect-to-gateway (P6.4) which sends the Student to the SSLCommerz Gateway

hyperedges.label: Question creation flow: Teacher form data is created/edited (P2.1), validated and stored (P2.2) into Question DB
CQ submission and grading flow: Student upload via P2.3 reaches P2.6 Progress Record, submission goes to P2.5 grading, grade request to P2.4 CQ Submission Receive
Question bank serving flow: Student query filters via P2.3 are answered from P2.2/Question DB, returning MCQ List to Student
Sequential five-sprint delivery timeline for Prepare Yourself (Feb – Dec 2026): Foundation -> Payment/Mock Tests -> Learning Content -> Analytics/Admin -> Results & Submission
Contest detail page load: GET /contests/{pk}/ fetches Contest via get_object_or_404, get_or_create ContestParticipant (score=0), renders contest_detail.html
Answer submission flow: POST {question_id, answer} -> check correct_option -> increment participant score -> query leaderboard order_by(-score)[:20] -> JSON {score, rank, leaderboard[]}
CQ submission flow: student posts written-question photos, CQView creates WrittenSolveSubmission and returns 201
Teacher grading flow: teacher posts marks and comment to TeacherFeedback model, which creates a Notification badged to the student
User login authentication flow
hyperedges.source_location: full login sequence: POST /login/ -> authenticate -> SELECT user -> session/redirect or error

hyperedges.label: MCQ answer submission flow: student POSTs answer, view checks Question model, records result in UserProgress, returns JSON {correct, hint}
Async feedback flow: progress recording triggers FeedbackReady notify to Teacher Feedback, which sends notification to student at /student/notifications/
Subscription purchase flow via SSLCommerz hosted checkout
IPN validation and subscription activation flow

nodes.label: CI Pipeline (GitHub Actions)
nodes.rationale: Runs on every push/PR to main: ruff F821 undefined-name lint, Django system check, missing-migrations check, then unit tests. Uses a CI-only SECRET_KEY so no production secret is ever needed in the workflow.

nodes.label: Unit Test Suite (core/test.py)
nodes.rationale: Layer 1 of the two-layer test strategy: model logic, view responses, and form validation. Required to pass before any PR is merged.

nodes.label: Selenium E2E Test Suite (core/test_selenium/)
nodes.rationale: Layer 2 of the test strategy: 190+ browser-driven user-flow tests organized into 15 domain modules (auth, exams, contests, grading, etc.). Requires Chrome; driver auto-downloaded via webdriver-manager.

nodes.label: Conventional Commit Message Style
nodes.rationale: type(scope): description format with types feat/fix/refactor/test/docs/chore, wrapped at 72 chars.

nodes.label: PrepareYourself Platform
nodes.rationale: Bangladesh exam-prep platform for SSC & HSC students built by a 4-person Scrum team over one semester. Core value: adaptive board-specific practice, teacher grading, live contests, and curated study resources at an affordable price.

nodes.label: Question Bank Feature
nodes.rationale: MCQ & CQ (Creative) questions filtered by board, class, subject, year, and chapter — mirrors how Bangladeshi board exams are actually organized.

nodes.label: Exam Engine (MCQ + CQ phases)
nodes.rationale: Timed MCQ phase followed by CQ written submission with photo upload per part (ka/kha/ga/gha) — replicates the real two-part SSC/HSC board exam structure.

nodes.label: Teacher Grading System
nodes.rationale: Verified teacher accounts claim CQ submissions and grade per-part with comments, because creative questions cannot be auto-graded.

nodes.label: Contest System
nodes.rationale: Scheduled competitive exams with live leaderboards, ratings, coins, and badges.

nodes.label: Bilingual UI (Bangla/English)
nodes.rationale: Full interface in Bangla and English, user-selectable. Implemented as a LANG context variable checked inline in every template rather than Django i18n, keeping translations colocated with markup.

nodes.label: Tech Stack
nodes.rationale: Django 6.0.5 + Python 3.12; SQLite in dev with PostgreSQL via DATABASE_URL for production flexibility; Tailwind CDN + GSAP/Lenis for frontend; Anthropic API for AI note/MCQ generation and Gemini for OCR; Gunicorn + WhiteNoise for deployment without a separate static server.

nodes.label: Dev/Test Dependencies (requirements-dev.txt)
nodes.rationale: Selenium, webdriver-manager, and ruff are split out of runtime requirements so production installs stay lean.

nodes.label: Base Template (base.html)
nodes.rationale: Single layout shell loading Tailwind CDN, GSAP+ScrollTrigger, Lenis, KaTeX, and Google Fonts (Latin + Bengali pairs). Exposes title/extra_head/content/scripts blocks for child templates.

nodes.label: Global Search Modal (Ctrl+K)
nodes.rationale: Debounced (220ms) fetch to the search_api endpoint, grouped results (questions/notes/papers), keyboard navigation, scoped to the student's board & class.

nodes.label: Dark Mode Toggle
nodes.rationale: Theme class applied in a blocking head script before paint to prevent flash; color-scheme meta declared so Brave/Chrome do not force their own dark mode. Persisted in localStorage key py-theme.

nodes.label: KaTeX Math Rendering Setup
nodes.rationale: Loaded from CDN with SRI integrity hashes; exposes window.renderMath() so dynamically inserted content can re-render math. throwOnError:false keeps malformed teacher-entered LaTeX from breaking pages.

nodes.label: GSAP + Lenis Scroll Animation System
nodes.rationale: Replaces AOS: data-aos attributes are driven by GSAP ScrollTrigger; Lenis smooth scroll is wired into the GSAP ticker so both share one RAF loop.

nodes.label: Client-side Bangla Digit Converter
nodes.rationale: When LANG is bn, walks all text nodes on DOMContentLoaded converting 0-9 to Bengali numerals, skipping SCRIPT/STYLE/INPUT/TEXTAREA/SELECT/CANVAS — a blanket conversion so individual templates need not localize digits.

nodes.label: Tailwind Brand Recolor (blue->emerald, purple->teal)
nodes.rationale: tailwind.config remaps the blue and purple palettes to emerald/teal values so the entire site was rebranded without editing thousands of existing utility classes in templates.

nodes.label: Navbar (includes/navbar.html)
nodes.rationale: Role-aware navigation: superadmin sees crown link, admins see Manage Panel, students see coins/upgrade/progress. Active-link state derived from request.resolver_match.url_name compared against page-group strings.

nodes.label: Manage Panel Dashboard Template
nodes.rationale: Admin hub: 5 stat cards (questions/boards/subjects/classes/exam papers), 3 themed operation columns, recent questions, and pending note requests. Urgent items (pending grades, note requests) surface as header badges.

nodes.label: Manage Boards Template
nodes.rationale: Delete confirmation warns the admin that the board's N questions will cascade-delete permanently.

nodes.label: Manage Questions List Template
nodes.rationale: Filterable (board/subject/class/year/type) paginated question table with auto-submit selects; base_qs preserves filters across pagination links.

nodes.label: Question Add/Edit Form Template
nodes.rationale: Dual-mode form toggled by question_type: MCQ mode shows multi-row MCQ list + bulk paste (Add only), WRITTEN mode shows stimulus/hint/solution file uploads. Stimulus text is required only for CQ.

nodes.label: Bulk MCQ Import Template
nodes.rationale: Batch MCQ entry where Basic Info (board/subject/class/year) and one optional file are shared across the whole batch, so admins importing a year's paper enter metadata once.

nodes.label: Create Exam Paper Template
nodes.rationale: Single form saving MCQ and CQ phases together. Three input paths feed the same form: manual rows, bulk text paste, and image OCR — minimizing teacher data-entry effort.

nodes.label: preprocessImageForOCR
nodes.rationale: Browser-side image preprocessing before Tesseract.js: upscale to 1800px min side, grayscale, then adaptive thresholding via an integral image (15px window, C=8) — improves OCR accuracy on photographed Bengali exam papers. OCR runs entirely in the browser because Tesseract.js is free (no server API cost).

nodes.label: Bengali MCQ Option Label Auto-Detection
nodes.rationale: isBengali() regex-tests for the Bengali Unicode block and live-switches MCQ option labels between a/b/c/d and ka/kha/ga/gha as the teacher types, so mixed-language question banks always show culturally correct option letters. Duplicated identically across three manage templates.

nodes.label: Edit Exam Paper Template
nodes.rationale: Same form as create but pre-filled; warns when active_attempt_count > 0 that editing may affect students mid-exam, because saving re-saves all MCQ and CQ questions.

nodes.label: Exam Paper Preview Template
nodes.rationale: Teacher/Admin-only preview that reveals correct MCQ answers (highlighted green) — explicitly gated because it leaks answer keys.

nodes.label: Grade Queue Template (claim/release)
nodes.rationale: Three tabs: Unclaimed, My Queue, Graded by Me. Claim/release semantics prevent two teachers grading the same attempt; submissions older than 24h are flagged Urgent in red.

nodes.label: CQ Grading Template (per-part marks)
nodes.rationale: Split view: student answer photos (full + per-part a-d) on the left, sticky per-part scoring form on the right. Comment textareas auto-hide when a part gets full marks — teachers only explain deductions. Re-grade mode warns that saving notifies the student.

nodes.label: gradeFromTotal (JS grade scale)
nodes.rationale: Live grade preview using the Bangladeshi GPA letter scale: 80+ A+, 70 A, 60 A-, 50 B, 40 C, 33 D, else F.

nodes.label: Note Requests Management Template
nodes.rationale: PENDING/FULFILLED/REJECTED workflow. Fulfilling can either link a newly written note (study_note_add?req=pk) or quick-mark fulfilled without one.

nodes.rationale: MCQ and CQ phase pages are full standalone HTML documents (own <html>, CDN Tailwind) instead of extending base.html, removing the site navbar so students cannot navigate away mid-exam; a fixed timer bar auto-submits the form when time expires.

nodes.label: Onboarding Wizard (3-step study space setup)
nodes.rationale: Three client-side steps (board, class, subjects+goal) with shake animation on missing required radio; personalizes all content filtering to the student's board/class. Skippable via 'Skip for now' so onboarding never blocks access.

nodes.rationale: Development-only sandbox replacing a real payment gateway: explicit 'Simulate Success' / 'Simulate Failure' buttons POST a result to payment_process so the full upgrade flow (plan activation vs failure redirect) is testable without charging anyone. A yellow warning banner makes the test-environment status unmistakable.

nodes.label: Payment Success Page (receipt + next steps)
nodes.rationale: After payment it branches on needs_onboarding: new payers are pushed into the onboarding wizard before studying, existing users go straight to the dashboard.

nodes.label: Practical Lab Page (3-tab interactive lab)
nodes.rationale: Single page hosting three canvas simulations behind tabs; hidden panels have zero-size canvases so the tab switcher re-resizes on activation via requestAnimationFrame.

nodes.rationale: One requestAnimationFrame loop drives all three labs but only updates/draws the active tab, capping dt at 0.05s to avoid physics jumps after tab-away.

nodes.label: Ohm's Law (V = I x R) interactive teaching
nodes.rationale: Slider-driven voltage/resistance with live current, power, bulb brightness, I-squared-R resistor heating, overload flicker, and electron drift opposite to conventional current arrows — connects the formula to observable behavior instead of rote memorization.
nodes.norm_label: ohm's law (v = i x r) interactive teaching

nodes.label: Standing Wave / Superposition (v = f x lambda)
nodes.rationale: 'Add Reflected Wave' toggle overlays two faint counter-propagating waves with the bright resultant 2A sin(kx)cos(wt), marking nodes/antinodes; a highlighted red particle proves the medium only bobs up-down while the wave pattern travels.
nodes.norm_label: standing wave / superposition (v = f x lambda)

nodes.label: Molecular Bonding & Geometry (covalent/ionic, VSEPR shapes)
nodes.rationale: Break/Form bond buttons scatter and re-snap atoms via spring physics, with bond-order rendering (single/double/triple/ionic dashed), orbiting valence electrons, lone pairs, and a dipole compass for polar molecules — kinesthetic chemistry with bilingual facts per molecule.

nodes.label: Practical Videos Page (YouTube library)
nodes.rationale: Thumbnails swap to youtube-nocookie.com iframes only on click — no YouTube scripts load up front and the privacy-enhanced domain is used; thumbnail onerror falls back to img.youtube.com/vi/{id}/0.jpg.

nodes.label: Profile Page (role-aware: student/teacher/superadmin)
nodes.rationale: One template branches on is_admin/is_superadmin: students see rating, streak, badges, subscription and study scope; teachers see teaching-subject management; all roles share the collapsible Edit Account panel.

nodes.rationale: Role-split rendering: teachers see correct answers, per-question attempt stats and edit/delete; students get interactive MCQ buttons, a sticky sidebar navigator with green/red answer dots, and written questions link out to a dedicated practice page.

nodes.label: Teacher Verification Flow (NID + qualification upload, manual review)
nodes.rationale: Choosing the Teacher (ADMIN) role reveals required subject expertise, bio, NID photo and qualification certificate fields; accounts are reviewed before activation to keep content-management privileges away from unverified users.

nodes.label: Note AI Tools (askAI Q&A, MCQ generate, summarize)
nodes.rationale: askAI sends the striptagged note content with each question to /study-notes/ask-ai/ so the model answers in-context; MCQ generation and summarize are teacher-only buttons hitting per-note endpoints; answers run through window.renderMath for KaTeX.
nodes.norm_label: note ai tools (askai q&a, mcq generate, summarize)

nodes.label: Reading Progress Tracker (scroll % synced to backend)
nodes.rationale: Scroll percent is POSTed to /study-notes/{id}/read-progress/ only when it changes by >= 5% (lastSent throttle) to limit request volume; the bar and badge are seeded server-side from read_progress.scroll_percent so progress persists across visits.
nodes.norm_label: reading progress tracker (scroll % synced to backend)

nodes.label: Comment Moderation Workflow (pending approval by teacher)
nodes.rationale: Student comments are invisible until a teacher approves them — teachers see a Pending Approval queue with approve/delete actions, students see a notice that approval is required.
nodes.norm_label: comment moderation workflow (pending approval by teacher)

nodes.label: Recent Users Inline Management Table
nodes.rationale: Latest 10 sign-ups with inline role/plan edit, cancel-subscription and delete forms so the admin never leaves the dashboard; superadmin rows are marked Protected and excluded from edits/deletes.

nodes.label: Subscription Plan Breakdown Widget
nodes.rationale: Uses Django widthratio to render Free/Basic/Premium percentages and a stacked proportion bar without any JS charting library.

nodes.label: Syllabus Detail Page
nodes.rationale: Renders syllabus.content with the |safe filter, trusting admin-authored rich HTML produced by the TinyMCE editor in syllabus_form.

nodes.label: TinyMCE Rich Text Editor Init
nodes.rationale: TinyMCE 7 loaded from tiny.cloud CDN with an embedded API key; gives admins WYSIWYG syllabus authoring (tables, images, code samples) instead of a plain textarea.

nodes.label: Syllabus List Page
nodes.rationale: Slate-Indigo themed list with board/subject/class GET filters that auto-submit on change; admin-only Add/Edit/Delete controls gated by is_admin context flag; bilingual EN/Bangla copy via LANG variable.

nodes.label: Syllabus Subject Regroup Rendering
nodes.rationale: Uses Django {% regroup syllabi by subject %} to render per-subject group headers with item-count pills, relying on the view ordering syllabi by subject for correct grouping.

nodes.label: Pending Teacher Applications Section
nodes.rationale: Shows NID and qualification document upload status plus previews, with approve form and a hidden reject form requiring a reason textarea that is sent to the teacher.

nodes.label: Approved Teachers Subject Assignment Section
nodes.rationale: Radio inputs (not checkboxes) enforce exactly one subject per teacher when posting to assign_teacher_subjects.

nodes.label: Teacher Application Pending Gate Page
nodes.rationale: Intentionally standalone — does NOT extend base.html — so unapproved teachers see a locked gate page without site navigation; reimplements dark mode via localStorage py-theme key and Tailwind CDN, shows rejection_reason if the application was denied, and is fully bilingual EN/Bangla.

nodes.label: Add Practical Video Form
nodes.rationale: Accepts only the YouTube video ID (the part after v=) rather than a full URL, simplifying embed rendering downstream.

nodes.label: Virtual Contest Replay Page
nodes.rationale: Practice-mode replay of a past contest with the original time limit; explicitly causes no rating change and submissions appear on the leaderboard with a VIRTUAL tag, letting users experience contest pressure without rating risk. Posts answers (q_<pk> fields, MCQ radio 1-4 or textarea) to the same contest_submit endpoint as live contests.

nodes.label: Virtual Contest Countdown Auto-Submit Timer
nodes.rationale: Client-side setTimeout loop seeded from contest.duration_minutes; force-submits the form when time expires so virtual attempts respect the original duration.

nodes.label: Written CQ Practice Page
nodes.rationale: Single template serving three role/state variants: teacher view (solution upload + submissions review), student submitted view (own photos + teacher solution reveal), and student upload view. Teacher solution is deliberately hidden until the student submits.

nodes.label: Student 4-Part Handwritten Answer Upload Form
nodes.rationale: All four parts (photo_ka, photo_kha, photo_ga, photo_gha) are required image uploads posted multipart to submit_written_solve; completing the submission awards +10 marks.

nodes.label: Teacher Solution Upload/Delete Panel
nodes.rationale: Accepts image/PDF/DOC solution files via upload_question_solution; solution_is_image flag switches between inline render and a download link. Delete posts to delete_question_solution with confirm guard.

nodes.label: Teacher Student-Submissions Review List
nodes.rationale: Lists every student's 4-part photos with Complete/Partial status badges and a per-submission delete form posting to delete_student_submission.

nodes.label: Four-Part CQ Answer Structure (ka/kha/ga/gha)
nodes.rationale: Bangladeshi creative-question (CQ) convention: every written answer has exactly four labeled parts ক/খ/গ/ঘ (a/b/c/d), mirrored as photo_ka..photo_gha fields across submission upload, student review, and teacher grading views.

hyperedges.label: Contest scoring and leaderboard flow

hyperedges.description: Teacher supplies contest details to P3.1, which references P3.2 question assignment and triggers P3.4 activation
Payment confirmation flow: SSLCommerz IPN POST is received by P6.5, callback data passes to P6.6 which verifies the IPN signature via P6.3 and saves the subscription to the Subscription DB
Checkout initiation flow: Student views plans (P6.1), clicks Buy to initiate checkout (P6.2), plan ID drives redirect-to-gateway (P6.4) which sends the Student to the SSLCommerz Gateway

Question bank serving flow: Student query filters via P2.3 are answered from P2.2/Question DB, returning MCQ List to Student
